# GitHub users whose fork PRs get the Bazel remote-execution farm
# (.github/workflows/bazel-farm.yml). One numeric user id per line, the login
# as a comment; blank lines and # comments are ignored. Ids, not logins: a
# renamed account's old login can be registered by anyone. Look an id up
# with: gh api users/<login> --jq .id
#
# Read only from the base branch (the pull_request_target run's own commit),
# never from a PR: editing this file in a PR changes nothing until it merges.
# Both the PR author and the user who triggered the run (opener or pusher)
# must be listed, and the PR must come from the author's own fork. A listed
# user gets same-repo-PR-level trust: its PR code runs with the RBE client
# certificate. Same people as gascity's .github/blacksmith-allowlist.txt.
# rbe-west's rbe-fork-mint reads this file too, from the default branch, by
# the same rules: a listed author's own-fork PR, triggered by a listed user,
# gets rbe-fork tier rw (bazel.yml mode fork-rw: the trusted OSS pool) when
# the farm has rw switched on; everyone else gets tier ro (fork pool). A
# line that is not a numeric id makes the mint treat the list as empty.
8082291 # julianknutsen
91582 # quad341
36544495 # sjarmak
2568253 # csells
